title: What Each Vacation Package Product Includes
content:
The six Vacation Package Products differ chiefly in what the price already covers. Main meals, standard drinks, resort or ship gratuities, airport or port transfers and a tour manager accompanying the party throughout are each either included in the package price or charged separately, entirely according to the product booked. Where gratuities are not included the product publishes a charge per traveller per day; where transfers are not included it publishes a charge per traveller for a return transfer.

| Product | Main meals | Standard drinks | Gratuities | Gratuities per traveller per day | Transfers | Return transfer per traveller | Tour manager throughout |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | not included | not included | not included | 0.00 USD published | not included | 45.00 USD | not accompanied |
| Flex Bundle Package | not included | not included | not included | 0.00 USD published | included | 0.00 USD | not accompanied |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | included | included | included | 0.00 USD published | included | 0.00 USD | not accompanied |
| Escorted Tour Package | included | not included | not included | 12.00 USD | included | 0.00 USD | accompanied |
| Ocean Cruise Package | included | not included | not included | 18.50 USD | included | 0.00 USD | not accompanied |
| Luxury Collection Package | included | included | included | 0.00 USD published | included | 0.00 USD | accompanied |

## How the entries sit together

Two of the six products carry nothing at table: the Value Bundle Package and the Flex Bundle Package include neither meals nor drinks. Two carry everything: the All-Inclusive Resort Package and the Luxury Collection Package include meals, drinks and gratuities alike, and each accordingly publishes a gratuity figure of nil because no gratuity is charged separately at all. The Escorted Tour Package and the Ocean Cruise Package sit between them, with meals included but drinks and gratuities charged separately at 12.00 USD and 18.50 USD per traveller per day respectively.

The Value Bundle Package is the single product of the six on which transfers are not included, and it is accordingly the only one publishing a return transfer charge above nil, at 45.00 USD per traveller. A tour manager accompanies the party throughout on the Escorted Tour Package and the Luxury Collection Package alone.
